info.name: Mailchimp Search for Tags on a List by Name.

params.name: list_id
params.description: The unique ID for the list.

params.name: name
params.description: The search query used to filter tags.  The search query will be compared to each tag as a prefix, so all tags that have a name starting with this field will be returned.

items.docs: Search for tags on a list by name. If no name is provided, will return all tags on the list.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: query
params.description: The search query used to filter results.

items.docs: Search all campaigns for the specified query terms.
